sections.content: The recovery plan defines R0 through R5 trust and handoff requirements. Requests, successor identity, authorization refresh, legacy RED compatibility, historical replay, and completion handoff must be hash-bound, replay-safe, and fail closed on required source drift or invalid state.
sections.title: Requirements

sections.content: terminal_full validates Quick Dev terminal state by slice or full suite. It produces non-authorizing terminal receipts, validates fixed candidate-source manifests and required bindings, and emits an immutable completion receipt only when the full success predicate passes.
sections.title: Terminal Validation

sections.content: migration_bridge materializes declared RED test templates without overwriting differing files. validate_all provides R0 through R4 slice validation and hash binding. Completion-handoff tests verify stable content-based candidate roots and exclude generated evidence paths.
sections.title: Supporting Tools
